market_summary: Across all monitored assets during the New York session, markets are digesting recent downside expansion moves. Major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), indices (US100), and crypto (BTCUSD) are all trading beneath their respective intraday VWAP and EMA50 baselines. However, prices are either resting directly on session low supports or consolidating inside value areas on subdued grey RVOL volume, with CVD momentum tapering off. With GEX regimes signaling dampening in gold and extended negative gamma stretch in US100 following sweeps of session lows, risk-reward does not support chasing breakdown continuations or knife-catching counter-trend longs. A disciplined HOLD is maintained across the board.

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 3875.39 to VAH 3901.96) and below POC 3894.76, indicating mean-reversion chop. 2) CVD: CVD is -3.93 with BEARISH label, while short-term slope (+1.33) is curling up during the bounce, creating mild divergence. 3) Session: NEW_YORK_SESSION active. 4) Trend/Baselines: Price remains below declining VWAP (3895.05) and EMA50 (3891.46). 5) ATR Channel: Price is recovering from the lower ATR band (3867.46) and currently sits mid-channel below EMA20 baseline (3885.85). 6) Volume Confirmation: RVOL is 1.133 with no yellow spike (last spike 7 bars ago). 7) S/R & GEX: GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price above Gamma Flip (3869.37); price successfully bounced off Put Wall #1 (3873.08) and Session Low (3867.64), but is capped below S/R resistance at 3887.45 and Call Wall #1 (3894.90). In dampening regime with price mid-range inside VA, setup edge is low.
